name: Downers Grove Museum
summary: The village history campus, anchored by the 1846 Blodgett House and run by the park district.

primary_moment.title: The Blodgett House
primary_moment.excerpt: Israel Blodgett, a blacksmith, built this house in 1846, a generation before the railroad. It is one of the oldest surviving buildings in the village, and family tradition holds that the Blodgetts sheltered freedom seekers on the…
